text: For hatred does not cease by hatred at any time: hatred ceases by love, this is an old rule.
zh: 因为仇恨在任何时候都不会因仇恨而停止：仇恨会因爱而停止，这是一条古老的规则。

text: The world does not know that we must all come to an end here;--but those who know it, their quarrels cease at once.
zh: 世人并不知道我们都必须到此为止；但那些知道这一点的人，他们的争吵立刻就会停止。

text: He who lives looking for pleasures only, his senses uncontrolled, immoderate in his food, idle, and weak, Mara (the tempter) will certainly overthrow him, as the wind throws down a weak tree.
zh: 只求享乐而生的人，感官不受控制，饮食不节制，懒惰而软弱，魔罗（诱惑者）一定会推翻他，就像风吹倒弱树一样。

zh: 若人生活不求欢愉，六根精进，饮食节制，忠诚而坚强，魔罗必定不会推翻他，如同风吹落石山一样。

text: They who imagine truth in untruth, and see untruth in truth, never arrive at truth, but follow vain desires.
zh: 那些在非真理中想象真理、在真理中看到非真理的人永远不会到达真理，而是追随虚幻的欲望。

text: They who know truth in truth, and untruth in untruth, arrive at truth, and follow true desires.
zh: 那些在真理中认识真理、在非真理中认识非真理的人，能够达到真理，并追随真正的愿望。

text: As rain breaks through an ill-thatched house, passion will break through an unreflecting mind.
zh: 正如雨水冲破茅草屋，激情会冲破不加思考的心灵。

text: As rain does not break through a well-thatched house, passion will not break through a well-reflecting mind.
zh: 正如雨不能冲破茅屋，激情不能冲破善于思考的心灵。

text: The evil-doer mourns in this world, and he mourns in the next; he mourns in both.
zh: 恶人今世悲哀，来世也悲哀；他在两者中都哀悼。

text: He mourns and suffers when he sees the evil of his own work.
zh: 当他看到自己工作的邪恶时，他感到悲伤和痛苦。

text: Earnestness is the path of immortality (Nirvana), thoughtlessness the path of death.
zh: 精进是不朽之道（涅槃），放逸是死亡之道。

text: Those who are in earnest do not die, those who are thoughtless are as if dead already.
zh: 认真者不死，轻率者已死。

text: These wise people, meditative, steady, always possessed of strong powers, attain to Nirvana, the highest happiness.
zh: 这些智者，禅定、稳定，常具强大力量，证得涅盘，即无上的快乐。

text: Fools follow after vanity, men of evil wisdom.
zh: 愚人追随虚荣，人追随邪恶的智慧。

zh: 智者将真诚视为他最好的珠宝。

text: Follow not after vanity, nor after the enjoyment of love and lust!
zh: 不追求虚荣，也不追求爱欲的享受！

text: He who is earnest and meditative, obtains ample joy.
zh: 热心而禅修的人，会获得充足的快乐。
